description: Enterpret helps teams understand what customers are saying across support tickets, sales calls, app reviews, surveys, Slack, and more. Ask natural-language questions to find complaint trends, feature requests, segment-specific patterns, and direct customer quotes. Results are grounded in your customer context graph and include links back to source records so product, GTM, and leadership teams can act with context.
